notes.title: Ver1.0.7
notes.content:
The mode of about 30 minutes is added.
　⇒Many guests will be coming in.
　*If you feel the operation is too slow, please lower the image quality.

notes.title: Ver1.0.6
notes.content: Added the ability to skip endings.

notes.title: Ver1.0.5
notes.content:
Fixed a minor bug.
The size of the UI displayed in the center of the screen has been increased.

notes.title: Ver1.0.4_fix
notes.content:
Short mode (approx. 15 min.) is added.
　⇒Massive number of guests will be coming in for a short period of time.
　*If you feel the operation is too slow, please lower the image quality.

notes.title: Ver1.0.3
notes.content:
The speed of running has been improved.
The speed of displaying text in conversations has been improved.
Improved some of the loading speed.
The frequency of throwing goods has been reduced.
